visibleTestCases.title: Initial Account Balances
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Accounts = [{account, 1, <<"Alice">>, 100}, {account, 2, <<"Bob">>, 50}], P = ledger_actor:start(Accounts), B1 = ledger_actor:get_balance(P, 1), B2 = ledger_actor:get_balance(P, 2), ledger_actor:stop(P), {B1, B2} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Retrieves verified initial balances for Alice and Bob.

visibleTestCases.title: Deposit and Insufficient Funds Withdrawal
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Accounts = [{account, 1, <<"Alice">>, 100}], P = ledger_actor:start(Accounts), {ok, 150} = ledger_actor:process_transaction(P, {deposit, 1, 50}), Err = ledger_actor:process_transaction(P, {withdraw, 1, 200}), {ok, Final} = ledger_actor:get_balance(P, 1), ledger_actor:stop(P), {Err, Final} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Deposits 50 (balance becomes 150), rejects 200 withdrawal and preserves 150 balance.

visibleTestCases.title: Atomic Inter-Account Transfer
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Accounts = [{account, 1, <<"Alice">>, 100}, {account, 2, <<"Bob">>, 50}], P = ledger_actor:start(Accounts), {ok, 70} = ledger_actor:process_transaction(P, {transfer, 1, 2, 30}), {ok, B2} = ledger_actor:get_balance(P, 2), ledger_actor:stop(P), B2 end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Transfers 30 from Alice to Bob, leaving Alice with 70 and Bob with 80.

visibleTestCases.title: Batch Processing Transactions
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Accounts = [{account, 1, <<"Alice">>, 100}, {account, 2, <<"Bob">>, 50}], P = ledger_actor:start(Accounts), Txs = [{deposit, 1, 20}, {withdraw, 2, 100}, {transfer, 1, 2, 40}], {ok, App, Rej} = ledger_actor:process_batch(P, Txs), {ok, B1} = ledger_actor:get_balance(P, 1), {ok, B2} = ledger_actor:get_balance(P, 2), ledger_actor:stop(P), {App, Rej, B1, B2} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Applies valid deposit and transfer, rejects invalid withdrawal, returning final balances 80 and 90.
